failure_summary.description: Used a past-events endpoint as a substitute for the requested upcoming events.
Limited fallback selection to the named provider and omitted other potentially relevant available tools.

patch.reasoning: The existing protected guidance already explicitly rules out substituting past events for future events, so it should not be duplicated. The additional guidance clarifies that a provider mentioned in a past-workflow narrative does not, by itself, limit fallback selection to that provider, while preserving capability and scope checks.

edits.content: - A provider mentioned only as part of a past-workflow narrative does not restrict the search to that provider. Unless the user explicitly requires that source, inspect the full available-tools list for relevant supported coverage across providers. Use a broader result only for the facets its documentation supports; do not imply that it provides an unsupported topic, time, or category filter.
